review_question: In adults with type 2 diabetes, how does metformin, compared with placebo or another glucose-lowering intervention, affect HbA1c?
provenance: Constructed from synthetic clinical fixtures conforming to docs/review-question.md and evals/screening/fixtures.json.

records.title: Efficacy of metformin versus placebo in type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
records.abstract_text: Background: In adults with type 2 diabetes, metformin is commonly used as first-line therapy. Methods: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial evaluated metformin versus placebo over 24 weeks in 350 adult patients. Results: Patients receiving metformin achieved a statistically significant reduction in HbA1c of 1.1%. Conclusion: Metformin monotherapy significantly improves glycemic control compared with placebo.

records.title: Metformin versus placebo in type 2 diabetes: 2-year glycemic durability extension
records.abstract_text: Follow-up extension of double-blind randomized clinical trial in adult type 2 diabetes patients comparing metformin against placebo. Durability of HbA1c lowering was maintained at 24 months without excess hypoglycemia.

records.title: Comparative clinical trial of oral metformin versus sulfonylurea monotherapy in adult diabetics
records.abstract_text: Objective: To compare glycemic control between metformin and glimepiride in adults with type 2 diabetes. Methods: A multicenter comparative trial enrolled 420 diabetic patients randomized to oral metformin or sulfonylurea for 52 weeks. Outcome: Mean change in HbA1c was -1.2% in the metformin arm vs -0.8% with sulfonylurea.

records.title: Metformin extended-release versus immediate-release in poorly controlled type 2 diabetes: randomized study
records.abstract_text: Randomized comparative study comparing extended-release metformin with immediate-release formulation in 280 adult diabetic patients. Both arms showed significant reduction in hemoglobin A1c from baseline (p < 0.001) with improved gastrointestinal tolerability in the extended-release cohort.

records.title: Metformin combined with lifestyle intervention versus lifestyle alone in adults with newly diagnosed T2D
records.abstract_text: A prospective comparative clinical trial evaluated metformin plus lifestyle intervention against lifestyle intervention alone in 190 adults with type 2 diabetes. Patients receiving metformin achieved greater HbA1c reductions at 6 months (-1.4% vs -0.6%).

records.title: Triple therapy with metformin, SGLT2 inhibitor, and DPP-4 inhibitor in type 2 diabetes: randomized trial
records.abstract_text: In adults with uncontrolled type 2 diabetes mellitus on background metformin, the addition of dapagliflozin versus placebo was assessed in a double-blind randomized controlled trial. Primary outcome: placebo-corrected reduction in HbA1c was -0.78% at week 24.

records.title: Comparative efficacy of metformin versus pioglitazone in overweight adult patients with type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Design: A 12-month randomized open-label comparative trial in 210 adult diabetic patients. Patients were allocated to metformin 1000 mg twice daily or pioglitazone 30 mg daily. Results: Both treatments produced significant HbA1c lowering (-1.1% vs -1.0%).

records.title: Early intensive insulin therapy versus oral metformin in newly diagnosed adult type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Methods: A randomized controlled trial compared temporary intensive insulin with oral metformin therapy in 260 adult patients with severe hyperglycemia. Both interventions substantially lowered HbA1c and restored beta-cell preservation over 1 year.

records.title: Metformin versus DPP-4 inhibitor as add-on therapy in type 2 diabetes: randomized clinical investigation
records.abstract_text: A comparative clinical study evaluated oral metformin versus sitagliptin in adults with type 2 diabetes failing dietary management. Metformin achieved superior glycemic durability and lower HbA1c at 36 weeks.

records.title: Dose-escalation randomized evaluation of metformin in elderly adult patients with type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: A randomized trial examined metformin 500 mg, 1000 mg, and 2000 mg daily versus placebo in 180 elderly adult patients with type 2 diabetes. Glycated hemoglobin HbA1c decreased in a dose-dependent manner.

records.title: Glycemic response to metformin monotherapy in adults with impaired fasting glucose and early type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Double-blind placebo-controlled study assessing metformin 850 mg twice daily versus placebo in 310 adult individuals with early type 2 diabetes. Significant reduction in mean HbA1c observed over 48 weeks.

records.title: Evaluation of metformin versus acarbose in Asian adult patients with type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: A randomized active-comparator trial compared metformin to acarbose in 240 adult patients with type 2 diabetes. Primary endpoint: mean change in HbA1c at 24 weeks was -1.15% with metformin compared with -0.85% with acarbose.

records.title: Metformin action on beta-cell function and glycemic durability in type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Clinical prospective trial in adult diabetic patients receiving oral biguanide metformin. Metformin lowered HbA1c and improved HOMA-B index compared to baseline controls.

records.title: Comparative cohort study of metformin versus sulfonylurea on cardiovascular risk and HbA1c in T2D
records.abstract_text: A prospective comparative cohort study in 1200 adults with type 2 diabetes comparing long-term metformin versus sulfonylurea. Metformin cohort exhibited lower HbA1c (-0.9% difference) and decreased cardiovascular events.

records.title: Efficacy of metformin versus placebo in prediabetic adults with metabolic syndrome: 3-year trial
records.abstract_text: Randomized placebo-controlled trial evaluating metformin 850 mg twice daily versus placebo in 500 adults with metabolic syndrome and elevated HbA1c. Metformin significantly reduced HbA1c progression to overt diabetes.

records.title: Randomized comparison of metformin and vildagliptin in drug-naive adult type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Clinical trial in 260 adult patients with type 2 diabetes randomized to metformin monotherapy or vildagliptin. Both arms achieved significant reduction in HbA1c from baseline (-1.3% vs -1.1%).

records.title: Metformin versus lifestyle intervention in morbidly obese adults with type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Comparative clinical trial in 150 adults with BMI > 35 and type 2 diabetes. Patients were randomized to metformin plus lifestyle or lifestyle alone. Metformin group achieved superior glycemic control with HbA1c decline of 1.2%.

records.title: Twice-daily versus once-daily metformin formulations in type 2 diabetes: randomized crossover trial
records.abstract_text: A randomized crossover study in 90 adult diabetic patients comparing glycemic control between twice-daily immediate-release and once-daily extended-release metformin. HbA1c levels were equivalent across both treatment phases.

records.title: Metformin versus placebo for prevention of glycemic deterioration in adult diabetic patients
records.abstract_text: A double-blind placebo-controlled investigation of metformin therapy in adult type 2 diabetes. HbA1c decreased by 0.95% in the active treatment arm compared with placebo (p < 0.001).

records.title: Comparative study of metformin and empagliflozin monotherapy in adult type 2 diabetes
records.abstract_text: Multicenter trial evaluating metformin versus SGLT2 inhibitor empagliflozin in 320 drug-naive adults with type 2 diabetes. Both monotherapies demonstrated sustained reduction in HbA1c over 52 weeks.

records.title: Metformin regulates hepatic gluconeogenic enzyme expression in streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats
records.abstract_text: Preclinical animal model: male Sprague-Dawley rats were rendered diabetic with streptozotocin and treated with oral metformin 250 mg/kg daily. Metformin suppressed PEPCK and glucose-6-phosphatase mRNA in treated rodents. Preclinical rat study only, no human subjects.

records.title: Metformin prevents nephropathy progression in diabetic Wistar rats
records.abstract_text: Animal experiment: adult male Wistar rats with streptozotocin-induced diabetes received metformin or vehicle control. Renal histopathology and glomerular filtration in rodents were assessed. Preclinical animal research.

records.title: Hepatic AMPK phosphorylation by biguanides in C57BL/6J mice
records.abstract_text: Murine animal model: male C57BL/6J mice fed a high-fat diet were administered metformin intraperitoneally. Liver tissue phosphorylation kinetics and mitochondrial respiration were measured in animal cohorts.

records.title: Effects of biguanides on lipid peroxidation in diabetic rabbit retinas
records.abstract_text: Laboratory animal study: New Zealand white rabbits were induced with alloxan diabetes and treated with biguanides. Retinal oxidative stress markers were quantified in euthanized animals.

records.title: Metformin modulation of intestinal tight junctions in Sprague-Dawley rodents
records.abstract_text: Preclinical investigation in male Sprague-Dawley rats. Intestinal permeability and mucosal inflammation were evaluated in rats receiving metformin. Pure animal model research.

records.title: In silico molecular modeling of biguanide binding kinetics to human AMPK complex
records.abstract_text: A computational docking and molecular dynamics simulation explored metformin interaction with human AMPK. In silico binding energy was calculated at -7.8 kcal/mol. Pure computational modeling without human patients or living tissues.

records.title: Molecular dynamics simulation of organic cation transporter OCT1 binding to metformin
records.abstract_text: In silico structural simulation: 100-nanosecond atomistic molecular dynamics simulated binding cavity trajectories of OCT1 with biguanides. Theoretical computational calculations without empirical clinical trial.

records.title: Density functional theory calculations of metformin tautomerism and metal chelation
records.abstract_text: Quantum chemical simulation: density functional theory (DFT) at the B3LYP/6-31G level investigated copper and zinc chelation geometries with metformin. Theoretical physics and in silico modeling only.

records.title: Computational pharmacokinetic modeling of hepatic metformin clearance
records.abstract_text: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) computer simulation model simulating hepatic transport of biguanides. Differential equation mathematical model without clinical patient cohort.

records.title: In silico screening of biguanide derivatives against mitochondrial complex I
records.abstract_text: Virtual ligand screening and quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) simulation predicting complex I inhibition for novel biguanides. Computer simulation without biological testing.

records.title: Metformin-induced severe lactic acidosis in an 82-year-old female: a case report
records.abstract_text: We report a single case report of an 82-year-old female presenting with severe lactic acidosis (pH 6.9, lactate 18 mmol/L) during acute kidney injury while taking metformin. Hemodialysis led to recovery. Individual patient case description without comparative design.

records.title: Metformin intoxication with profound hypothermia in a solitary patient: case report
records.abstract_text: Single case report describing a 74-year-old man who developed deep accidental hypothermia and metabolic acidosis following biguanide accumulation. Single patient observational presentation.

records.title: Refractory metformin-associated lactic acidosis successfully treated with CVVHDF: a case report
records.abstract_text: Case report of a 68-year-old male presenting with acute on chronic renal failure and metformin accumulation. Continuous venovenous hemodiafiltration was initiated. Narrative single case report.

records.title: Metformin-induced pancreatitis in an elderly diabetic woman: case report
records.abstract_text: We describe a rare single case report of acute necrotizing pancreatitis attributed to metformin initiation in an elderly woman with normal renal function. Isolated case report lacking control group.

records.title: Efficacy of metformin in pediatric and adolescent patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus
records.abstract_text: A clinical study evaluating insulin requirements in children and adolescents aged 8-16 years with autoimmune type 1 diabetes receiving adjunct metformin. Off-target pediatric non-type 2 diabetes population.

records.title: Metformin treatment in pregnant women with gestational diabetes: neonatal outcomes
records.abstract_text: Clinical trial evaluating metformin in pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes during the third trimester. Off-target gestational diabetes population; not non-pregnant adults with type 2 diabetes.

records.title: Pharmacokinetics of oral metformin in healthy adult volunteers under fasting conditions
records.abstract_text: Phase 1 open-label pharmacokinetic study of metformin absorption and bioavailability in 24 healthy non-diabetic volunteers without type 2 diabetes. Healthy volunteer trial lacking clinical efficacy outcomes.

records.title: Historical perspective on the discovery and clinical adoption of biguanides: review
records.abstract_text: A narrative historical review detailing the extraction of guanidines from Galega officinalis and the synthesis of phenformin and metformin in the 20th century. Narrative literature overview without primary empirical comparative data.

records.title: In vitro suppression of cellular proliferation by metformin in human breast cancer cell lines
records.abstract_text: In vitro laboratory study: MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 malignant cell cultures were treated with metformin concentrations. Cell cycle arrest and apoptosis were assessed in vitro. Oncology cell study without diabetes clinical evaluation.

records.title: Editorial: New therapeutic horizons for metformin in longevity and geroscience
records.abstract_text: Editorial commentary discussing potential future clinical applications of biguanides in aging and healthspan. Opinion piece without original clinical trial data or comparative patient outcomes.
